description_en: Retrieves information about a certificate deployment task, including the task status, target resources, and certificates
description_zh: 通过CreateDeploymentJob创建部署任务后会获取任务ID，您可以通过该任务ID调用本接口获取部署任务详情
name: DescribeDeploymentJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment job. To get the job ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 部署任务ID。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html返回的任务**ID**。也可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html接口获取
parameters.name: job_id

Email.description_en: The email address of the contact

Mobile.description_en: The phone number of the contact

CertDomain.description_en: The domain names bound to the certificate of the deployment task
CertDomain.description_zh: 部署任务证书包含域名（多个）
CertDomain.title_en: 部署任务证书包含域名（多个）
CertDomain.title_zh: 部署任务证书包含域名（多个）

CertType.description_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

upload: uploaded certificate

buy: purchased certificate

free: free certificate available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
CertType.description_zh:
证书类型。
upload：上传证书
buy：自购证书
free：个人测试证书（仅中国站支持）

Config.description_en: The configurations of the deployment task

Del.description_en:
Indicates whether the deployment job was deleted. Valid values:

0: not deleted

1: deleted
Del.description_zh:
删除标识，无实际意义。

0：未删除
1：已删除

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the deployment job. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 部署任务执行的结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）
EndTime.title_en: 部署任务执行结束时间
EndTime.title_zh: 部署任务执行结束时间

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the deployment job was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 部署任务创建时间（秒，时间戳格式）

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the deployment job was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
GmtModified.description_zh: 部署任务上次修订时间（秒，时间戳格式）
GmtModified.title_en: 部署任务上次修订时间
GmtModified.title_zh: 部署任务上次修订时间

Id.description_en: The ID of the deployment job

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the deployment task

JobType.description_en:
The type of the deployment job. Valid values:

cloud: multi-cloud deployment job.

trustee: hosted deployment job available only on the China site (aliyun.com).

user: cloud service deployment job. The cloud server is not included
JobType.description_zh:
任务类型。

cloud：多云部署任务
trustee：托管部署任务（仅中国站）
user：云产品部署任务（不含云服务器）

Name.description_en: The name of the deployment task

ProductName.description_en: The cloud services included in the deployment task
ProductName.description_zh: 部署任务资源包含云产品（多个）
ProductName.title_en: 部署任务资源包含云产品（多个）
ProductName.title_zh: 部署任务资源包含云产品（多个）

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Rollback.description_en:
Indicates whether the deployment job includes the rollback worker. For example, if a cloud service in a deployment job has been rolled back, 1 is returned. Valid values:

0: The rollback worker is not included.

1: The rollback worker is included
Rollback.description_zh:
是否包含回滚任务worker。例如某个部署任务中的某个云产品执行过回滚，则返回1。

0：不包含回滚任务worker
1：包含回滚任务worker

ScheduleTime.description_en: The time when the deployment job was scheduled. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
ScheduleTime.description_zh: 部署任务计划调度时间（秒，时间戳格式）
ScheduleTime.title_en: 部署任务计划调度时间
ScheduleTime.title_zh: 部署任务计划调度时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the deployment job. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 部署任务执行的开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）
StartTime.title_en: 部署任务执行开始时间
StartTime.title_zh: 部署任务执行开始时间

Status.description_en:
The status of the deployment job. Valid values:

pending

editing

scheduling

processing

error

success
Status.description_zh:
部署任务状态。

pending：待执行
editing：编辑中
scheduling：调度中
processing：部署中
error：部署失败
success：部署成功

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account in which the deployment job is created
UserId.description_zh: 部署任务创建人的阿里云账号ID
